title: Man admits drugging and raping wife over 20 years
description: A husband, who cannot be named to protect his wife's anonymity, pleads guilty to more than 60 offences, including rape and administering a substance with intent.

title: AI 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory, Anthropic co-founder says
description: Jack Clark says "most labs have different ways of being able to pull the plug", but says this may need to be a requirement.

title: Burnham cancels engagements after death of his father
description: Burnham has previously said his father did not know he had become prime minister due to his Alzheimer's.

title: Farage says £72m donations are compliant 'with the law today'
description: Ministers are seeking to put a £100,000 annual cap on donations from British expats, backdated to 25 March 2026.

title: Macklemore dropped from Ed Sheeran tour after 'Free Palestine' speech
description: The US rapper was condemned by Jewish groups after making comments criticising Israel.

title: Staff slept while patient killed at NHS mental health unit
description: Inquest hears how Rolando Torres-Pena, 22, was able to strangle and kill Hugo Flint-Cahan on a hospital ward in east London.

title: Harry and Meghan to have security review and children change school
description: The level of police protection they need and potential dangers they face are to be reviewed.

title: Member of UK armed forces dies in road traffic incident in Ukraine
description: The incident is not the result of hostile action, the BBC understands.

title: Immigrants held in small outdoor cages at 'Alligator Alcatraz' in Florida, investigators find
description: DHS inspectors say they found the immigration-detention centre violated basic standards for hygiene, medical care, food and safety.
